info.title: C2C Merchant API
info.description: Create deposit and withdrawal orders, query order status and wallet balance. Every request is authenticated with a merchant API key in the C2C-API-Key header (Authorization: Bearer is also accepted). Deposit and withdrawal requests also carry an MD5 'signature' field in the JSON body; order creation always enforces it. The Merchant API has no request rate limits. See the Signature Generation Guide.

post.summary: Create a deposit or withdrawal order
post.description: orderType=Deposit returns a hosted paymentPageUrl for the customer, who first enters the wallet account they pay from there and is then given a receiving account of exactly the requested walletType (payment method); orderType=Withdrawal pays the customer's account (customerAccountNumber, or entered by the customer on the hosted page when omitted) and accepts walletType JazzCash, Easypaisa, EasypaisaTillID or BankAccount only. Orders are always accepted. A deposit is always created with status Queued and stage Awaiting: no member is assigned at creation, only when the customer submits the account they pay from on the hosted page (if no assignment succeeds during 3 attempts over 60 seconds by default, the order fails with CancelledTimeout). A withdrawal with no eligible member available is created with status Awaiting (stage Awaiting) and assigned later. merchantOrderRef allows one live (in progress or completed) order per merchant. The body must carry a valid 'signature' (always enforced). Retrying the same signed body with the same Idempotency-Key is safe; the same signed body under a different Idempotency-Key → 401 SIGNATURE_REPLAYED.

200.description: Order created, or the existing order for a repeated Idempotency-Key with the same terms. A new deposit always has status Queued and stage Awaiting (no member assigned yet). A new withdrawal has status AwaitingMemberPayout (stage Assigned), or Awaiting (stage Awaiting) when no eligible member is available yet or the customer still has to enter their account on the hosted page.

400.description: Validation failed ({error}), e.g. amount with more than 4 decimal places or not less than 100,000,000,000,000, or a withdrawal on a deposit-only walletType (JazzCashTillID, JazzCashQR, EasypaisaQR); or request could not be bound, e.g. missing Idempotency-Key / unknown enum (application/problem+json).

401.description: API key missing, invalid or revoked (empty body); or the body's signature is missing, malformed, invalid or replayed (SignatureError body).

403.description: Merchant account not active, or caller IP not whitelisted.

409.description: merchantOrderRef is already used by an order of this merchant that is in progress or completed. References of failed orders (Rejected, Expired, CancelledTimeout, Cancelled, CancelledAuto) can be reused.

example.error: merchantOrderRef 'INV-10045' is already used by order ORD-20261008120620-3f6b. Reuse the same Idempotency-Key to retry a request, or use a new reference for a new payment.

413.description: Request body larger than 64 KB (code PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE).

422.description: Withdrawal's amount + fee not covered by the merchant's available balance (which excludes withdrawals in progress, including Awaiting), payment method (walletType) disabled for the merchant and order type, amount outside the limit of the payment method (code order.amountOutOfRange; deposits per walletType: 1,000 to 50,000 PKR for JazzCash and Easypaisa, 300 to 50,000 PKR for the Till ID and QR methods and for BankAccount; withdrawals per provider: 500 to 50,000 PKR for Easypaisa and JazzCash), or Idempotency-Key already used with different terms (orderType, amount, walletType, currency, merchantOrderRef or customerAccountNumber).

example.error: This Idempotency-Key was already used for a different order request.

get.description: Returns the status, lifecycle stage and milestone timestamps of one of the merchant's orders, looked up by either C2C identifier: the orderId or the orderReference. Scoped to the merchant: works with any of the merchant's API keys, including after key rotation.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The orderId (UUID) or the orderReference (ORD-...) returned at creation and in webhooks.

401.description: API key missing, invalid or revoked. Empty body.

404.description: No order with this orderId or orderReference for this merchant.

get.description: Returns the latest order the merchant created with the given merchantOrderRef, or the order with the given C2C orderReference, with its lifecycle stage and milestone timestamps. Send exactly one of the two query parameters. Authenticated by the API key alone; no signature.

parameters.name: merchantOrderRef
parameters.description: The merchantOrderRef sent at order creation (URL-encoded). Send this or orderReference.

parameters.name: orderReference
parameters.description: C2C's orderReference (ORD-...). Send this or merchantOrderRef.

400.description: Neither merchantOrderRef nor orderReference sent, or both sent.

value.error: Provide an orderId, an orderReference or a merchantOrderRef.
Provide either an orderReference or a merchantOrderRef, not both.

401.description: API key missing, invalid or revoked. Empty body.

404.description: No order with this merchantOrderRef or orderReference for this merchant.

401.description: API key missing, invalid or revoked. Empty body.

404.description: API key not found or inactive.

ApiKey.name: C2C-API-Key
ApiKey.description: Merchant API key (mk_live_<32 alphanumeric>) sent as C2C-API-Key: mk_live_...

BearerApiKey.description: Alternative for existing integrations: Authorization: Bearer mk_live_... (C2C-API-Key wins when both are sent).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Unique per order and API key; reuse it for every retry of that order. A repeat with the same terms returns the original order; a repeat with different terms (orderType, amount, walletType, currency, merchantOrderRef, customerAccountNumber) returns 422. The same signed body sent with a different key within 24 hours returns 401 SIGNATURE_REPLAYED.

WalletType.description: The payment method. JazzCash = JazzCash account number; JazzCashTillID = JazzCash Till ID; JazzCashQR = JazzCash QR code; Easypaisa = Easypaisa account number; EasypaisaTillID = Easypaisa Till ID (named TillID before; TillID is no longer accepted); EasypaisaQR = Easypaisa QR code; BankAccount = bank account. Deposits: the customer is only ever given a receiving account of exactly the requested method (JazzCash and Easypaisa mean the account number only; request JazzCashTillID or EasypaisaTillID for a Till ID). A BankAccount deposit is paid into a member's bank account by bank transfer from the customer's JazzCash or Easypaisa wallet; the customer chooses which of the two on the hosted payment page. Withdrawals: JazzCash, Easypaisa, EasypaisaTillID or BankAccount only; JazzCashTillID, JazzCashQR and EasypaisaQR are deposit-only and rejected with 400.

OrderStatus.description: Final success: Completed (legacy Confirmed). Final failure: Rejected, Expired, CancelledTimeout, Cancelled, CancelledAuto. Others are in progress. Deposit path: Queued (created; the customer has not submitted the account they pay from; no member assigned) → Awaiting (only while a member is looked for: up to 3 attempts over 60 seconds by default) → AwaitingCustomerPayment (member assigned and account shown; waiting for the payment to arrive and the member to confirm it) → Completed (the member confirms that the payment arrived). AwaitingMemberConfirmation (the payment was reported as sent; the member is verifying it) comes before Completed only when C2C operations set it: the hosted page no longer reports payments. Deposit failures: CancelledTimeout (no member could be assigned during the 3 attempts over 60 seconds), Expired (the checkout link expired before the customer started, or before a payment was confirmed), Rejected (the member reports that the payment did not arrive). An order in AwaitingMemberConfirmation no longer expires with the checkout link; it moves to ManualReview if the member does not decide in time. Withdrawal: Awaiting = accepted, waiting for an eligible member or for the customer's account; AwaitingMemberPayout = member assigned.

OrderStage.description: Canonical lifecycle stage: Awaiting → Assigned → Sent → Approved / Rejected → Completed / Failed. Approved/Rejected currently happen in the same step as Completed/Failed, so the current stage is normally one of the other five. Status to stage: Awaiting, and Queued while no member is assigned (every new deposit) → Awaiting; AwaitingCustomerPayment, AwaitingMemberPayout → Assigned; Completed → Completed; Rejected, Expired, CancelledTimeout, Cancelled, CancelledAuto → Failed. A deposit normally goes straight from Assigned to Completed.

OrderLifecycle.description: Current stage and when each milestone was reached (ISO 8601 UTC; null = not reached).

awaitingAt.description: When the order started waiting for an eligible member. Null if a member was assigned at creation, which only happens for withdrawals.

assignedAt.description: When a member was assigned. Deposit: after the customer submitted the account they pay from on the hosted page.

sentAt.description: Deposit: the member confirmed that the payment arrived; the same timestamp as approvedAt and completedAt (orders created before this release: when the customer reported the payment on the hosted page). Withdrawal: member sent the payout.

failedAt.description: When the order ended without settlement.

amount.description: At most 4 decimal places and less than 100,000,000,000,000. Must be within the amount limit of the payment method (both ends included), otherwise 422 with code order.amountOutOfRange. Deposits, per walletType: 1,000 to 50,000 PKR for JazzCash and Easypaisa; 300 to 50,000 PKR for JazzCashTillID, JazzCashQR, EasypaisaTillID, EasypaisaQR and BankAccount. Withdrawals, per provider: 500 to 50,000 PKR for Easypaisa, EasypaisaTillID and JazzCash; no limit for BankAccount.

merchantOrderRef.description: Optional. One live (in progress or completed) order per reference per merchant; a reference whose earlier order failed can be reused. Queryable via GET /api/merchant/orders/status.

customerAccountNumber.description: Withdrawals: the customer's receiving account. Optional — when omitted the order is accepted as Awaiting and the customer enters their account on the hosted page (paymentPageUrl) before a member is assigned. Ignored for deposits.

customerAccountName.description: Withdrawals: the name the customer's account is held in, shown to the member who pays it. Only accepted together with customerAccountNumber.

callbackUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL for this order's webhooks; defaults to the Merchant Portal setting. Must resolve to a public internet address (loopback, private and link-local addresses are refused at delivery); redirects are not followed.

successUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL. The hosted payment page sends the customer here when the order completes, appending c2c_order_id, c2c_order_reference and c2c_status.

failureUrl.description: Absolute http(s) URL. The hosted payment page sends the customer here when the order is rejected, expires or is cancelled (same parameters appended).

txnRefDigitsRequired.description: Deprecated: accepted (4 to 8) so existing integrations do not break, but ignored. It used to set how many trailing digits of the wallet transaction ID the customer entered on the hosted payment page; the page no longer asks for a transaction ID on any payment method. No effect on withdrawals.

maxRetryCount.description: Deprecated: accepted (0 to 10) so existing integrations do not break, but ignored. A withdrawal whose member cannot pay it out (not enough funds, or the payout window passes) goes to another member, never back to the same one, until the withdrawal deadline (120 minutes from creation by default); then, if nobody can take it, to ManualReview. It is never failed for this.

signature.description: Lowercase hex MD5 (32 characters) of the other top-level fields, excluding null, empty-string, object and array values: keys lowercased, sorted in ASCII order, joined as key=value with '&', followed directly by the API key's signing secret (sksec_...). Values are signed as written in the body.

paymentPageUrl.description: Hosted page for the order. Deposits: the customer enters the wallet account they pay from, is assigned a member's account and pays there. Withdrawals: the customer enters their receiving account there when the order was created without one, and can follow the payout. Pre-signed; expires at expiresAt.

status.description: Initial status. Deposit: always Queued (no member assigned yet). Withdrawal: AwaitingMemberPayout when a member was assigned, or Awaiting when no eligible member was available yet or the customer still has to enter their account on the hosted page.

stage.description: Initial lifecycle stage. Deposit: always Awaiting. Withdrawal: Assigned or Awaiting.

fee.description: Merchant fee, fixed when the order was accepted (deposit: re-quoted if the customer pays with a different payment method than requested; capped at the deposit amount).

availableBalance.description: Funds usable now. Withdrawals in progress are already taken out.

reservedBalance.description: Amount + fee of the withdrawals still in progress.

code.description: Machine-readable reason, present on refusals a client may want to handle in code. order.amountOutOfRange: the amount is outside the limit of the payment method.
